about: The corbels' faces (Magic's req 687, 1.8): every stone corbel carved as a head under the beams of the Tudor rooms the Architect's schedule gives (docs/architect/materials-by-room.md, tudor-pink stone with a beams ceiling), each a different face, the masons' joke on one another. Every year. Only lids, brows and jaw move; no head turns, no face speaks. The places are the model's ids, hyphens as spaces; the drawing Design's (req 688).

show: the stone faces carved on the corbels under the beams asleep, lids down, jaws slack
